data.name: Laaibah
data.gender_notes: Laaibah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'al-la'ab', which means 'the delicate one'. This name is often given to girls who are thought to possess a delicate and fragile nature, yet are also beautiful and graceful. The name Laaibah carries the meaning “Delicate, Fragile” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Laaibah usually hope their child will grow to embody delicate, fragile and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the fragility and beauty of creation, and the importance of treating all beings with care and compassion.
data.etymology: Laaibah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Delicate, Fragile.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Laaibah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: لائبة
in_arabic.meaning: لائبة تعني اللعبة أو الشيء الذي يلعب
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم لائبة مشتق من اللغة العربية و يعني اللعبة أو الشيء الذي يلعب. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء الجميلة و الرقيقة التي تحمل معاني لطيفة و محببة. في اللغة العربية، اللعب يوحي بالفرح و السرور، و هكذا يكون الاسم لائبة محملًا بالسعادة و الخفة.

in_urdu.name: لائبہ
in_urdu.meaning: لائبہ کا مطلب ہے کھیل یا تفریح
in_urdu.long_meaning: لائبہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے کھیل یا تفریح. یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے لئے اہم ثقافتی اور مذہبی معانی رکھتا ہے. لائبہ نام کی لڑکیوں کو اکثر خوشگوار اور زندہ دل کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے.
